tools.name: search_tutorials
tools.description: Search hundreds of tutorials and articles on kirupa.com covering JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML5 Canvas, animations, React, and data structures & algorithms using full-text search (FTS5 + BM25). Returns matching tutorials with canonical URLs, clean Markdown URLs, matching section headings, and ex

tools.name: get_tutorial
tools.description: Fetch the complete, clean Markdown text and extracted code blocks of a kirupa.com tutorial by its URL, section/slug identifier (e.g. "javascript/closures_in_javascript"), slug, or title.

tools.name: find_related_links
tools.description: Given a topic, concept, or an existing kirupa.com tutorial URL/slug, find related kirupa.com tutorials with ready-to-use Markdown links and summaries.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List all topic sections on kirupa.com with tutorial counts and sample articles, or list the tutorials inside a specific section.
